programme.title: Vivarium

programme.title: Under The Silver Lake

programme.title: Slumdog Millionaire
programme.desc: A young orphan from the slums of Mumbai, who is one question away from the Who Wants To Be A Millionaire jackpot, is arrested on suspicion of cheating.

programme.title: Upstream Color
programme.desc: A woman is abducted and hypnotised with an organic material harvested from a specific flower. When she falls for a man, the two realise he may also have been subjected to the same process.

programme.title: A Bittersweet Life
programme.desc: In this neo-noir thriller, a gangster assigned to spy on his bosss mistress finds himself in danger after sparing her and her secret lover. Tensions rise as loyalty, betrayal, and survival collide.

programme.title: Oasis
programme.desc: An irresponsible and childish ex-con befriends a girl with cerebral palsy and develops a progressively stronger bond with her.

programme.title: Society
programme.desc: A Beverly Hills teen discovers his parents are part of a gruesome orgy cult for the social elite.

programme.title: The Chaser
programme.desc: A former police officer turned pimp starts searching for missing women who worked for him. He discovers they all visited the same client before disappearing, leading him into a dark and violent hunt.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: Baron strikes up a friendship with his new cellmate, a man with a history of prison breaks. As they hatch a plan to escape, Baron recalls how he met the love of his life.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A story told both forwards and backwards in time about an ex- insurance investigator, unable to remember new thoughts, who uses notes and tattoos to hunt for the man he thinks killed his wife.

programme.title: I Saw The Devil
programme.desc: The line between good and evil begins to blur when a special agent goes on the hunt for a serial killer who brutally murdered his pregnant fiancee.

programme.title: The Last Stop In Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a travelling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: You Were Never Really Here
programme.desc: Joe (Joaquin Phoenix) is a hired gun who rescues trafficked girls, using brutal methods against those responsible.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: An aspiring writer is repeatedly sexually abused, humiliated, and left for dead by four men whom she systematically hunts down to seek revenge, inflicting upon them every horrifying and torturous moment they carried out on her.

programme.title: Audition
programme.desc: A widower accepts his friend's offer to audition girls in order to search for his new wife. However, the girl he likes does not appear to be the one she claims to be.

programme.title: Pulse
programme.desc: An employee of a floral shop hangs himself when a colleague goes to his apartment to investigate his absence from work.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Sisters
programme.desc: On returning home from a mental health facility, two sisters find that, along with their stepmother, they have to find a way to deal with their late mother's ghost who begins to haunt them.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica meets a James Dean-type newcomer who suggests they kill off the popular kids and end cruel, unfair treatment the girls impose on unpopular kids at school.

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: The story of a teenager who struggles through school and family life by escaping into a fantasy world of magic and monsters.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: A suburban dwelling man looking for some change and excitement becomes a corporate spy, but after meeting a mysterious woman he begins to question everything.

programme.title: The Thicket
programme.desc: A tough bounty hunter is hired to find a ruthless killer and recruits an unlikely group for a dangerous journey into a deadly wilderness.

programme.title: The Science Of Sleep
programme.desc: A man entranced by his dreams and imagination is love-struck with a French woman and feels he can show her his world.

programme.title: Severance
programme.desc: A bonding weekend goes horribly wrong for seven colleagues who find themselves facing the chop when they are sabotaged by a deadly enemy. Only the smartest will survive this brutal office outing.

programme.title: Synchronic
programme.desc: Two New Orleans paramedics' lives are ripped apart after they encounter a series of horrific deaths linked to a designer drug with bizarre, other-worldly effects.

programme.title: Dark Water
programme.desc: A mother going through a divorce moves into a run down apartment with her daughter. Visions of a missing girl, and other eerie phenomena become increasingly menacing.

programme.title: Lars And The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars is content with his artificial girlfriend; a life-sized doll named Bianca. But when he develops feelings for an attractive co-worker, Lars finds himself lost in a unique love triangle.

programme.title: Showgirls

programme.title: Blue Is The Warmest Colour

programme.title: Under The Silver Lake

programme.title: Noroi: The Curse

programme.title: The Wind

programme.title: The Fall

programme.title: G.I. Samurai

programme.title: Timecrimes

programme.title: Following

programme.title: The Paper Tigers

programme.title: Black Robe

programme.title: Caligula: The Ultimate Cut
